text:
Elena (partnerships): quick cross-team sync — marketplace listing + HW partner certification + SI previews. need to lock embargo, hero copy, and a hardware compliance blur for press. who can take what?
Greg (marketing): i'll draft the press + blog. i'll prepare partner-forward hero + neutral fallback. posting drafts by 14:00 UTC. :pencil:
Hana (product): staging at staging.redwood.com/ecosystem-listing. missing: partner topology SVG + firmware hash for the HW partner badge. if missing i'll swap to generic diagram.
Leo (solutions): SI preview plan: live tech walkthrough preferred. need terraform module or simple deploy snippet + sandbox creds and a small sample dataset. if creds arrive late we'll record a guided demo.
Priya (legal): legal needs signed approval (email ok) for any partner quote and the HW compliance blurb. embargo must include UTC timestamp. avoid benchmarking claims without partner-provided docs.
Elena (partnerships): embargo set to Fri 14:00 UTC. partners must provide assets + signed approvals by Thu 18:00 UTC or we default to neutral messaging and a later partner spotlight.
Greg (marketing): noted. i'll prepare a fallback CTA "Explore Marketplace" and a partner CTA "Try the Partner Integration" and queue both in CMS so we can flip.
Hana (product): small QA: when logo missing mobile hero collapses. i'll add an aspect-ratio placeholder and max-height patch today. low risk.
Leo (solutions): pinged SI partner for creds — they said token + endpoint after security checklist. @Elena can you nudge for ETA? i'll draft run-through script now.
Elena (partnerships): nudging partner PM now. @ops-bot please open a ship ticket and assign owners.
ops-bot: created ticket RED-ECO-9001: "Marketplace co-announce & HW partner certification" assigned to Greg/Hana/Leo, due 2025-03-20 18:00 UTC. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-ECO-9001
Priya (legal): quick guidance — HW compliance blur should be factual (e.g., "validated for X firmware versions"). if partner won't sign, use generic "works with PartnerName devices" without version claims.
Greg (marketing): will ask partner for signed compliance statement. also drafting a short social cadence for launch day.
Hana (product): for the integration snippet please provide either a docker-compose excerpt or a tiny k8s manifest. example curl auth template i can accept:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  https://partner.example.com/api/v1/infer \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
That'll let us show a quick developer example.
Leo (solutions): demo runbook uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/si/ecosystem-demo-v1.md — teams can comment.
Elena (partnerships): checklist (copying into thread):
```
- Embargo: Fri 14:00 UTC
- Partner assets (logo SVG, topology, firmware hash): due Thu 18:00 UTC
- Signed quote + compliance blurb: due Thu 18:00 UTC
- Hero copy variants: Greg -> 14:00 UTC
- SI creds + deploy snippet: Partner -> Leo -> aim today
- Staging placeholder patch: Hana -> deploy by EOD
- Ship ticket: RED-ECO-9001
```
Greg (marketing): posting draft hero in-thread in 30m. tagging @Priya for legal check on wording.
Priya (legal): will review draft asap. if partner delays, we'll use neutral hero and omit partner name from headline.
Elena (partnerships): agreed. final: if all assets + approvals land by Thu 18:00 UTC we go with partner co-announce Fri 14:00 UTC. if not, neutral announce + plan partner spotlight post-launch. escalate blockers here and i'll follow up with partner. :bell:
